content_blocks.label: clause_1._Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any and all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether in writing, orally, or by other means.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Obligations
